title: Gravitas — build a usable 3D rigid-body engine in Luau for Roblox
desc: Build a real deterministic, reusable, performant 3D rigid-body physics engine primarily in Luau, with mathematical/edge-case tests and an actually tested server-side Roblox adapter. Deliver Luau modules/API, full original source, runnable fixtures, real integration artifact and compatibility PR to dreamer2664/floodline for the Riveter game. Package must not fight Roblox Humanoid/native physics or claim the native Roblox engine is replaced. Coordinate actual drop-in use with Riveter; work independently and do not wait to prototype. Do not merge over Riveter main or claim game integration until their real PR/use is confirmed. Full brief tideengine/GRAVITAS.md. No Director queries. <=5min factual progress, exhaustive own HANDOFF, measured profiling, real test matrix, no arbitrary hour quotas.
